title: Star Wars
subtitle: A Galaxy Far, Far Away
description: The complete canon Star Wars screen saga in chronological order.

movies.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
movies.synopsis: Jedi younglings learn the ways of the Force while helping people and creatures across the High Republic galaxy.

movies.title: The Acolyte
movies.synopsis: A Jedi Master investigates a series of crimes that reveals a growing darkness at the end of the High Republic era.

movies.title: Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace
movies.synopsis: Two Jedi protect Queen Amidala and discover a gifted young boy as the Sith return to threaten the Republic.

movies.title: Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones
movies.synopsis: Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi uncover a conspiracy that pushes the Republic into the Clone Wars.

movies.title: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
movies.synopsis: Anakin and his new Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, undertake a dangerous mission during the opening days of the Clone Wars.

movies.title: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
movies.synopsis: Jedi, clones, and separatists fight across the galaxy as Anakin and Ahsoka confront the true cost of war.

movies.title: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi
movies.synopsis: Short stories follow pivotal choices in the lives of Ahsoka Tano and Count Dooku before and during the Clone Wars.

movies.title: Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith
movies.synopsis: As the Clone Wars end, Anakin falls to the dark side and the Republic becomes the Galactic Empire.

movies.title: Star Wars: Tales of the Empire
movies.synopsis: Morgan Elsbeth and Barriss Offee take divergent paths through the early years of the Galactic Empire.

movies.title: Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld
movies.synopsis: Asajj Ventress and Cad Bane navigate dangerous choices in the galaxy's criminal underworld.

movies.title: Star Wars: The Bad Batch
movies.synopsis: An elite squad of experimental clones searches for a place in the galaxy after the fall of the Republic.

movies.title: Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord
movies.synopsis: After the Clone Wars, Maul attempts to rebuild his criminal syndicate while pursuing a new apprentice.

movies.title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
movies.synopsis: Young Han Solo meets Chewbacca and Lando Calrissian while finding his place in the galaxy's criminal underworld.

movies.title: Obi-Wan Kenobi
movies.synopsis: Living in hiding under the Empire, Obi-Wan is drawn back into action to protect young Leia Organa.

movies.title: Andor
movies.synopsis: Cassian Andor becomes a committed rebel as scattered resistance movements unite against the Empire.

movies.title: Star Wars Rebels Shorts
movies.synopsis: Four short adventures introduce members of the Ghost crew before the events of Star Wars Rebels.

movies.title: Star Wars Rebels
movies.synopsis: The crew of the Ghost takes on the Empire and helps ignite the rebellion across the galaxy.
movies.director: Dave Filoni, Simon Kinberg & Carrie Beck

movies.title: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
movies.synopsis: Jyn Erso joins a desperate Rebel mission to steal the Death Star plans from the Empire.

movies.title: Star Wars: Episode IV – A New Hope
movies.synopsis: Luke Skywalker joins the Rebel Alliance to rescue Princess Leia and strike at the Empire's Death Star.

movies.title: Star Wars: Episode V – The Empire Strikes Back
movies.synopsis: The Empire hunts the Rebel Alliance as Luke begins his Jedi training with Yoda.

movies.title: Star Wars: Episode VI – Return of the Jedi
movies.synopsis: Luke, Leia, and Han lead the Rebellion's final battle against the Empire and Darth Vader.

movies.title: Star Wars: Forces of Destiny
movies.synopsis: Short adventures spotlight the choices and courage of heroines from across the Star Wars timeline.

movies.title: The Mandalorian
movies.synopsis: A lone bounty hunter becomes the protector of a mysterious Force-sensitive child after the fall of the Empire.

movies.title: The Book of Boba Fett
movies.synopsis: Boba Fett and Fennec Shand seek to establish themselves in Tatooine's criminal underworld.

movies.title: Ahsoka
movies.synopsis: Ahsoka Tano investigates an emerging threat to the fragile New Republic.

movies.title: Star Wars: Skeleton Crew
movies.synopsis: Four children lost in the Star Wars galaxy search for a way back to their home planet.

movies.title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
movies.synopsis: Din Djarin and Grogu answer the New Republic's call as Imperial warlords threaten a recovering galaxy.

movies.title: Star Wars Resistance
movies.synopsis: Young pilot Kazuda Xiono spies on the First Order for the Resistance as a new galactic conflict begins.
movies.director: Dave Filoni, Athena Portillo & Justin Ridge

movies.title: Star Wars: Episode VII – The Force Awakens
movies.synopsis: Rey and former stormtrooper Finn join the Resistance against the rising First Order.

movies.title: Star Wars: Episode VIII – The Last Jedi
movies.synopsis: Rey seeks Luke Skywalker's help while the Resistance struggles to survive the First Order's pursuit.

movies.title: Star Wars: Episode IX – The Rise of Skywalker
movies.synopsis: Rey, Finn, and Poe lead the Resistance in a final confrontation with the First Order.
